text:
Asha (devex): Quick sync — final rollout checklist for the SDK + quickstarts. Changelog cutoff in ~2h. Who has PRs that need owner signoff or docs updates?

Lara (sdk): I have 2 PRs open: `sample-auth` and `token-refresh`. Both need doc links and a smoke pass on dedicated infra. ETA ~45m.

Ben (docs): I can take `sample-auth` doc edits. Can someone paste the final config snippet for the new auth flow? I'll update the quickstart and the changelog blurb.

Lara (sdk): pasted below — use exactly this in the quickstart (keeps parity with hosted API):
```
# example config for token-refresh
client_id: "redwood-sample-app"
auth: { type: "oauth2", refresh_enabled: true }
cache: { prefix_kv: true }
```

Ethan (eng-infra): FYI CI is flaky on linux-infra-3 — reran the `token-refresh` job, logs show intermittent network timeout. If you need a dedicated smoke pass, I can spin a small pool (5m) so it doesn't queue behind large runs.

Samir (qa): Ran the quickstart smoke locally against the dedicated pool (devex-sandbox). `sample-auth` passed except a single 502 on TTL renew. Repro steps: trigger refresh x10 in <1s. Logging attached in the PR.

Lara (sdk): Thanks @Samir — I have a fix for the race in the PR, pushing in ~15m. After that we should be green.

Ben (docs): For the changelog entry — propose one liner: "SDK: Add token refresh convenience helper and sample-auth quickstart (bugfix: refresh race)." Anyone want a slightly different phrasing?

Asha (devex): That works. Assigning owners: Lara -> SDK PR merge; Ben -> docs PR and changelog entry; Samir -> final smoke signoff; Ethan -> infra flake mitigation if it repros on dedicated pool. I'll track roll-forward window at 1h from now.

deploy-bot: build/token-refresh #342: queued -> started -> success :white_check_mark: (34m ago)

Samir (qa): After Lara's push tests are green on dedicated pool. Quick manual verify then I'll stamp `qa-approve`.

Lara (sdk): pushed fix and squashed commits. CI kicked off.

deploy-bot: build/token-refresh #343: queued -> failed :x: (connection timeout on linux-infra-3)

Ethan (eng-infra): Repro'd the timeout, increasing VM network retries. Kicked new dedicated job on `devex-sandbox-pool`.

Ben (docs): I'm drafting the quickstart change now — dropping a TODO in the PR for the final command output. Will ping when ready for review.

Samir (qa): New run on sandbox passed end-to-end. Logging shows TTL renew stable. I'll post the acceptance comment in the PR and add the changelog approval.

Asha (devex): Great — final asks before cutoff: 1) Lara merge SDK PR, 2) Ben merge docs + changelog entry, 3) Samir stamp QA, 4) Ethan monitor infra for 30m post-merge. If anyone slips, call it out here and we can gate the release. Otherwise I’ll start the release notes publish 10m after last merge. :thumbsup:

Lara (sdk): Merged SDK PR.

Ben (docs): Docs + changelog merged. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/664

Samir (qa): Stamped `qa-approve` in both PRs.

Ethan (eng-infra): Watching infra, no regressions so far.

Asha (devex): Awesome — closing the cutoff. Will publish notes in ~10m and trigger the sampleapp CI to build release artifacts. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
